note: 审计前正常轮换十段中英草稿。双凭据仅用于未泄漏且风险经审批的受控短期过渡，最终旧凭据及会话失效；无秘密值，无时间轴猜测。

series.title: 密钥轮换：安全过渡与旧凭据失效
series.premise: 审计要求证明对账API凭据生命周期受控，旧凭据无泄漏迹象，消费者清单包含定时任务但版本尚未核实。
series.outcome: 核实三个消费者，批准二十分钟受控双凭据窗口；灰度发现客户端缓存旧引用，修复刷新后验证全部消费者使用新凭据。按窗口撤销旧凭据及关联会话，受控拒绝检查与业务运行通过；审计签收限定于已验收控制，不宣称全系统合规。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 未来轮换演练候选，不计实际复现；不引用S46–S48或其他并行草稿。

dialogues.title: 审计要的是生命周期证据
dialogues.premise: 对账API轮换评审开始，审计要求证明旧凭据最终失效。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出轮换日期与控制有效证据的区别。

lines.en: We need rotation evidence for reconciliation. I'll take point on this review.
lines.zh: 对账需要轮换证据，这次评审我来协调。

lines.en: A change date isn't enough. Show creation, usage, revocation, and verification.
lines.zh: 变更日期不够，需要创建、使用、撤销及验证证据。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the old credential must fail afterward, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，之后旧凭据必须失败，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, including derived sessions where applicable. Consumers must still work afterward.
lines.zh: 对，包括适用的派生会话，之后消费者也必须仍工作。

lines.en: Maybe three clients need updates. I'll verify jobs rather than assume.
lines.zh: 可能三个客户端要更新，我核实任务，不先假设。

lines.en: What's the ETA for inventory? Tomorrow's audit isn't a reason to skip checks.
lines.zh: 清单预计多久？明天审计不能成为跳过检查的理由。

lines.en: Record any missing coverage honestly. Evidence should show limits, not hide them.
lines.zh: 如实记录覆盖缺失，证据要说明局限而非隐藏。

lines.en: A full identity redesign? Let's park that. Today's action item is controlled rotation.
lines.zh: 身份全面重设计？先放一边，今天待办是受控轮换。

lines.en: First confirm this isn't a leak response. Exposed credentials shouldn't get routine overlap.
lines.zh: 先确认不是泄漏应急，暴露凭据不应获得常规并存期。

lines.en: No leak indicator has been reported. Security still needs to confirm that assessment.
lines.zh: 目前没有报告泄漏迹象，安全团队仍需确认判断。

dialogues.title: 清单包括身份和派生会话
dialogues.premise: 安全评估未发现泄漏迹象，核对秘密库记录与提供方身份清单。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分秘密值、版本引用和撤销范围。

lines.en: Credential inventory matches one service identity. Two vault versions exist, one inactive.
lines.zh: 凭据清单对应一个服务身份，秘密库有两个版本，一个未启用。

lines.en: Don't reuse the inactive version blindly. Its history and scope need review.
lines.zh: 别盲目复用未启用版本，其历史和范围需要评审。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis was a spare. Maybe it belongs to an abandoned test.
lines.zh: 原假设是备用，可能来自废弃测试。

lines.en: Just to confirm, create fresh material, right? No values in meeting notes.
lines.zh: 确认一下，创建全新凭据，对吧？会议记录不放值。

lines.en: Correct. Map sessions and provider revocation behavior. Stored values aren't the whole identity.
lines.zh: 对。梳理会话和提供方撤销行为，存储值不是整个身份。

lines.en: I'm on it. Managed configuration holds references only. Vault access stays named.
lines.zh: 我来做。受管配置只存引用，秘密库访问保持实名。

lines.en: Check effective permissions before creating replacements. Don't perpetuate excess access during rotation.
lines.zh: 创建替代前检查实际权限，别在轮换中延续过宽访问。

lines.en: This identity needs reconciliation reads only. Writes use a separate reviewed role.
lines.zh: 这个身份只需对账读取，写入使用独立评审角色。

lines.en: Good. Record the old identity's permitted scope. That bounds overlap risk.
lines.zh: 好。记录旧身份允许范围，这限定并存风险。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, fresh limited credentials. Next confirm every consumer and owner.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，创建全新受限凭据，接下来确认所有消费者和负责人。

dialogues.title: 定时任务不能从清单消失
dialogues.premise: 确认读取范围与会话撤销能力，开始核对三个疑似消费者。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出消费者责任确认和实际使用记录如何相互核实。

lines.en: Consumer ownership covers the API and nightly job. A weekly exporter is unconfirmed.
lines.zh: 消费者归属覆盖API和夜间任务，周度导出尚未确认。

lines.en: Check its last run and deployment reference. Quiet traffic doesn't mean retirement.
lines.zh: 检查上次运行和部署引用，流量安静不代表退役。

lines.en: I'm on it. The weekly exporter still runs. Its owner is available today.
lines.zh: 我来查。周度导出仍运行，负责人今天在。

lines.en: Just to confirm, three consumers now, right? Each needs a validation plan.
lines.zh: 确认一下，现在三个消费者，对吧？各自需要验证计划。

lines.en: Yes, plus a usage search for unknown clients. Owner confirmation alone has limits.
lines.zh: 对，还要搜索未知客户端使用情况，只由负责人确认有局限。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Verify inventory against provider request identities too.
lines.zh: 我复述一下，也用提供方请求身份核对清单。

lines.en: Exactly. Include retries and restart behavior. Cached credentials can survive configuration changes.
lines.zh: 正是这样，包括重试和重启行为，配置改变后缓存凭据可能仍保留。

lines.en: We can't rule that out for the API. Maybe its client holds credentials in memory.
lines.zh: API不能排除这种情况，客户端可能将凭据保留在内存。

lines.en: Then validate refresh behavior before overlap starts. Don't discover it at expiry.
lines.zh: 那就在并存开始前验证刷新行为，别等到期才发现。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for that check? Set a stop condition if it fails.
lines.zh: 好，检查预计多久？如果失败要设置停止条件。

dialogues.title: 双凭据过渡必须有截止
dialogues.premise: 三个消费者均有负责人，测试环境刷新通过，但生产客户端版本需灰度核实。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出允许并存的安全条件和不可自动延期的边界。

lines.en: Bounded overlap is approved for twenty minutes. The maintenance window includes revocation checks.
lines.zh: 批准二十分钟有界并存，维护窗口包括撤销检查。

lines.en: What makes overlap acceptable here? State the security conditions explicitly.
lines.zh: 这里为什么可接受并存？明确说出安全条件。

lines.en: No exposure indicators, limited reads, monitored use. Both identities stay under vault control.
lines.zh: 无暴露迹象、读取受限、使用受监控，两个身份都在秘密库控制下。

lines.en: Just to confirm, deadline doesn't extend automatically, right? Maybe stop before activation if unready.
lines.zh: 确认一下，截止不会自动延长，对吧？未准备好可能在启用前停止。

lines.en: Correct. A suspected leak cancels routine overlap. Containment takes priority over availability.
lines.zh: 对。怀疑泄漏就取消常规并存，控制暴露优先于可用性。

lines.en: Go/no-go needs all owners present. Unexpected failures are the rollback trigger for pausing.
lines.zh: 继续或停止需要所有负责人在场，意外失败触发暂停评审。

lines.en: After revocation, rollback cannot revive old credentials. Use a reviewed replacement or pause.
lines.zh: 撤销后回退不能复活旧凭据，使用评审替代或暂停。

lines.en: The escalation path reaches security and service owners. I'll monitor provider identity usage.
lines.zh: 升级路径联系安全和服务负责人，我监控提供方身份使用。

lines.en: Reserve time for session invalidation. New logins failing isn't enough if sessions survive.
lines.zh: 留时间使会话失效，新登录失败还不够，会话可能仍存活。

lines.en: Okay, owners agree to pause on deadline failure. Controlled jobs won't send customer duplicates.
lines.zh: 好，负责人同意截止失败就暂停，受控任务不会给客户重复发送。

dialogues.title: 只传版本引用不传秘密
dialogues.premise: 过渡窗口与停止条件已审批，三个负责人就绪。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出新凭据创建成功不代表消费者已经使用。

lines.en: The secret version reference is ready. New credentials have the reviewed read scope.
lines.zh: 秘密版本引用已就绪，新凭据拥有评审过的读取范围。

lines.en: Confirm vault readers and delivery controls. A new secret can still be exposed.
lines.zh: 确认秘密库读取者和分发控制，新秘密仍可能暴露。

lines.en: Only the three workload identities can retrieve it. Human access is separately audited.
lines.zh: 只有三个工作负载身份能获取，人工访问另行审计。

lines.en: Just to confirm, values never enter logs, right? Use references in managed configuration.
lines.zh: 确认一下，值不会进入日志，对吧？受管配置使用引用。

lines.en: Yes. Check the reference resolves correctly. Configuration success doesn't establish runtime adoption.
lines.zh: 对。检查引用正确解析，配置成功不证明运行时已采用。

lines.en: I'm on it for the first client. Maybe a controlled read confirms delivery.
lines.zh: 我来处理首个客户端，一次受控读取可能确认分发。

lines.en: Use a synthetic reconciliation record. Don't print response contents into change notes.
lines.zh: 用合成对账记录，不把响应内容打印到变更记录。

lines.en: The smoke test is prepared. It checks identity and output without secret values.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试已准备，不暴露秘密值地检查身份和输出。

lines.en: Activate the overlap timer with provider confirmation. Keep one clear effective start.
lines.zh: 提供方确认时启动并存计时，保留明确实际开始时间。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for canary checks? Five minutes leaves room for revocation.
lines.zh: 好，灰度检查预计多久？五分钟能为撤销留时间。

dialogues.title: 引用已改客户端仍用旧缓存
dialogues.premise: 并存窗口开始，首个API客户端引用更新，但实际身份使用待验证。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出为什么配置与成功请求都可能掩盖未刷新。

lines.en: Credential refresh hasn't taken effect. Requests succeed, but provider logs show the old identity.
lines.zh: 凭据刷新没有生效，请求成功但提供方日志显示旧身份。

lines.en: Check the deployed client version. The test environment may have newer refresh support.
lines.zh: 检查部署客户端版本，测试环境可能有更新的刷新支持。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis was a cache delay. Actually, this client lacks automatic reload.
lines.zh: 原假设是缓存延迟，实际上这个客户端不支持自动重载。

lines.en: Just to confirm, expansion pauses, right? Our rollback trigger doesn't stop the timer.
lines.zh: 确认一下，暂停扩大，对吧？回退评审不会停止计时。

lines.en: Correct. No silent extension. If the deadline is missed, pause affected consumers.
lines.zh: 对，不能默默延期，错过截止就暂停受影响消费者。

lines.en: I'm on it for approved client reinitialization. Maybe two minutes, with requests drained.
lines.zh: 我按批准流程重新初始化客户端，排空请求后可能两分钟。

lines.en: Avoid dropping active transactions. Verify retry behavior before resuming the worker.
lines.zh: 避免丢弃活动事务，恢复工作进程前验证重试行为。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on the deadline. Twelve minutes remain for all checks.
lines.zh: 我盯截止时间，还剩十二分钟完成全部检查。

lines.en: The new identity now appears in logs. Still verify output and duplicate handling.
lines.zh: 日志现在出现新身份，仍需验证输出和重复处理。

lines.en: Okay, record the mismatch and correction. Continue only after the consumer owner confirms.
lines.zh: 好，记录不匹配和修正，消费者负责人确认后才继续。

dialogues.title: 每个消费者都有新身份记录
dialogues.premise: 首个客户端刷新和输出验证通过，夜间及周度任务受控验证开始。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分新身份使用证据与旧身份完全停用的证据。

lines.en: New-identity usage now covers all three consumers. Each controlled run used the new reference.
lines.zh: 新身份使用覆盖全部三个消费者，每次受控运行都用新引用。

lines.en: Did the scheduled jobs finish? Authentication records alone don't prove reconciliation output.
lines.zh: 定时任务完成了吗？认证记录本身不证明对账输出正确。

lines.en: Yes, the smoke test reconciles expected totals. Notifications were suppressed for test runs.
lines.zh: 是，冒烟测试对账总数符合预期，测试运行抑制了通知。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no old identity traffic now, right? Check background retries too.
lines.zh: 确认一下，现在没有旧身份流量，对吧？也检查后台重试。

lines.en: No observed traffic in the checked interval. That's not proof that no hidden consumer exists.
lines.zh: 检查期间未观察到流量，但不证明没有隐藏消费者。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on provider logs. Maybe delayed retries need another check.
lines.zh: 我继续盯提供方日志，延迟重试可能还需检查。

lines.en: Record the interval and inventory search. Then revoke within the approved deadline.
lines.zh: 记录检查区间和清单搜索，然后在批准截止内撤销。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Validated new calls don't automatically disable old access.
lines.zh: 我复述一下，新调用验证通过不会自动禁用旧访问。

lines.en: Exactly. Revocation is a separate control. Verify its effect after provider confirmation.
lines.zh: 正是这样，撤销是独立控制，提供方确认后验证效果。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, consumers are ready. Proceed with old-identity and session invalidation.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，消费者就绪，继续使旧身份和会话失效。

dialogues.title: 旧凭据拒绝会话也失效
dialogues.premise: 三个消费者验证新身份成功，仍处批准窗口内，开始撤销旧身份。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出控制面确认、拒绝检查与会话失效的不同证据。

lines.en: The old credential is invalid now. Provider confirmation arrived before the overlap deadline.
lines.zh: 旧凭据现在失效，提供方确认在并存截止前到达。

lines.en: Show the controlled rejection result. Also confirm associated sessions are invalidated.
lines.zh: 展示受控拒绝结果，也确认关联会话失效。

lines.en: Just to confirm, new consumers still work, right? We're back to baseline on outputs.
lines.zh: 确认一下，新消费者仍工作，对吧？输出回到基线。

lines.en: Yes, new calls pass. The approved old-session check rejects too.
lines.zh: 对，新调用通过，批准的旧会话检查也被拒绝。

lines.en: I'm on it for vault retirement. Old material stays inaccessible outside controlled evidence retention.
lines.zh: 我来退役秘密库材料，旧材料仅受控证据留存可访问。

lines.en: Okay, let's keep it under observation. Maybe hidden clients will report failures.
lines.zh: 好，继续观察，隐藏客户端可能报告失败。

lines.en: Any failure uses the escalation path. Don't reactivate old credentials to hide impact.
lines.zh: 失败走升级路径，别为了掩盖影响重新启用旧凭据。

lines.en: Agreed, pause affected work if needed. A fresh reviewed identity is the recovery option.
lines.zh: 同意，必要时暂停工作，新建评审身份是恢复选项。

lines.en: Keep monitoring through real scheduled runs. Controlled runs don't cover every timing condition.
lines.zh: 监控到真实定时运行，受控运行不覆盖所有时间条件。

lines.en: Record effective revocation and rejection times. The overlap is closed, not merely scheduled to close.
lines.zh: 记录实际撤销和拒绝时间，并存已经结束，不只是计划结束。

dialogues.title: 审计追踪不能包含秘密值
dialogues.premise: 旧凭据及会话验证失效，当前业务正常，整理轮换证据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解证据完整性与敏感材料限制访问的平衡。

lines.en: The audit trail needs approvals and effective results. Exclude secret values from the packet.
lines.zh: 审计追踪需要审批和实际结果，证据包排除秘密值。

lines.en: I'm on it. Managed configuration versions link to vault events without exposing material.
lines.zh: 我来做，受管配置版本关联秘密库事件，不暴露材料。

lines.en: Check timestamps and access controls. A complete record that's publicly readable creates risk.
lines.zh: 检查时间戳和访问控制，完整却公开可读的记录会制造风险。

lines.en: Just to confirm, retention policy is approved, right? Maybe audit needs longer coverage.
lines.zh: 确认一下，保留策略已批准，对吧？审计可能需要更长覆盖。

lines.en: The reviewer confirmed the period. Consumer results use sanitized record references only.
lines.zh: 评审人确认了期限，消费者结果只用脱敏记录引用。

lines.en: Include the cache mismatch and repair. Hiding that would weaken the evidence.
lines.zh: 包括缓存不匹配和修复，隐藏它会削弱证据。

lines.en: I'll attach runtime identity checks too. Installation notes alone wouldn't establish adoption.
lines.zh: 我也附上运行身份检查，仅安装记录不能证明采用。

lines.en: And preserve the old-session rejection evidence. It proves more than vault deletion.
lines.zh: 也保留旧会话拒绝证据，它比秘密库删除更有证明力。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, evidence records limits. The actual weekly schedule still awaits observation.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，证据记录局限，真实周度运行仍待观察。

lines.en: I'll label that follow-up clearly. Audit can review today's tested controls separately.
lines.zh: 我明确标记跟进，审计可单独评审今天已测控制。

dialogues.title: 签收限定控制不宣称全面合规
dialogues.premise: 审计证据包完整，真实周度运行跟进仍开放，审核今天的轮换控制。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出签收范围与遗留观察责任。

lines.en: Control sign-off covers today's rotation evidence. It isn't certification of every security control.
lines.zh: 控制签收覆盖今天轮换证据，不是认证所有安全控制。

lines.en: Okay, who's picking this up for weekly observation? Each action item needs closure evidence.
lines.zh: 好，谁接周度观察？每项待办都要结项证据。

lines.en: I'll review scheduled-run results with Anika. Unexpected failures must remain visible.
lines.zh: 我和Anika评审定时运行结果，意外失败必须可见。

lines.en: I'll own that next Tuesday. Maybe a dry rehearsal before then catches timing gaps.
lines.zh: 我负责下周二跟进，之前预演可能发现时间覆盖缺口。

lines.en: Just to recap, old access stays invalid. No fallback to retired material, right?
lines.zh: 小结一下，旧访问保持失效，不回退到退役材料，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. Any new replacement needs independent approval and the same controlled delivery.
lines.zh: 对，任何新替代都需独立审批及同样受控分发。

lines.en: I'll track client-version consistency separately. Test and production differed during this rotation.
lines.zh: 我单独跟踪客户端版本一致性，这次测试和生产不一致。

lines.en: That deserves a prevention task. Configuration review must include credential reload behavior.
lines.zh: 这需要预防任务，配置评审必须包括凭据重载行为。

lines.en: I'll close the loop on automation Friday. It checks runtime identity and deadline enforcement.
lines.zh: 周五我完成自动化反馈，它检查运行身份和截止执行。

lines.en: Agreed, signing this control won't close follow-up. I'll link results after the scheduled run.
lines.zh: 同意，签收控制不会关闭跟进，定时运行后我附上结果。
